messages.subject: Custom tick color
parts:
Hi there,
I've been scouring the list archives but can't find an answer to this.
Is there a way I can use custom tick colors? I.e. the first tick is
red, the second is green, the third is black, etc.

If this isn't possible, is there a way to set custom x axis label
colors? Basically I'd like to add a per-tick color annotation to the
bottom of my plot.

Thanks!
Greg

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Custom tick color
parts:
Hi,

I think it's not possible within ggplot (hoping to be proven wrong!),
but you could edit them after drawing,

library(ggplot2)
p <- qplot(1:10, 1:10, geom="blank")

p

g <- ggplotGrob(p)
# grid.ls(getGrob(g,"axis_h::axis.ticks.segments", grep = T))
grid.edit(gPath("axis_h", "axis.ticks.segments"), grep=TRUE,
gp=gpar(col=1:5))

HTH,

baptiste
